الهَقْعَةُ
Three small stars [ λ , �(assumed tropical:) 1, and �↓ 2, of Orion,] forming the points of a triangle, in the head of الجُوْزاَءُ The 5th Mansion of the Moon. (El-Kazweenee.) [This is accord. to those who make نَوْءٌ to signify the “ auroral setting: ” accord. to those who make it to signify the “ auroral rising, ” these stars compose الهَنْعَةُ, q. v.; and الهَفْعَةُ seems to consist of ?? 1 and ?? 2 of Orion.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
